title: Maximize the Profit as the Salesman
summary: Given the number of houses and offers from buyers specifying the range of houses they want to purchase and the gold they offer, determine the maximum gold that can be earned by selling houses to buyers without any house being sold to more than one buyer.
statement: Given the number of houses and offers from buyers specifying the range of houses they want to purchase and the gold they offer, determine the maximum gold that can be earned by selling houses to buyers without any house being sold to more than one buyer.
constraints: An accepted offer [start,end,gold] sells every inclusive house in that interval.
Choose nonoverlapping offers to maximize total gold.
hints: A schedule ending by house i either ignores i or accepts an offer ending there.
Group offers by end and store best profit for each house prefix.
Carry best[i], and for [start,i,gold] combine gold with best[start].
The prefix before start is exactly the largest nonoverlapping subproblem for that offer.
editorial: The prefix before start is exactly the largest nonoverlapping subproblem for that offer.

The offer paying ten is better than either overlapping alternative.
